title: A Festival Paused
narration: Paper lanterns wait in Festival Square. The beacon lens is missing, but Pip has heard singing reeds and Mira has noticed fresh marks near the orchard.

dialogue.text: Both leads are safe, and we can investigate one together.

choices.label: Follow Pip toward the singing reeds
Inspect the orchard path with Mira

continuityFacts: Festival preparations paused because the beacon lens was missing.
